Mistress '''Jharen''' was the innkeeper of [[The Light of Truth]] in [[Sienda]], [[Amadicia]]

== Appearance ==
She is plump with long curly gray hair.

== Activities ==
She provides a room to [[Elayne]] and [[Nynaeve]] after they encounter [[Valan Luca]]'s menagerie.{{ref/book|5|13}}
